definitions.explanation: A service or plan that allows unlimited usage for a fixed fee, commonly used for data plans, streaming services, and all-you-can-eat/drink offers.

examples.japanese: データ{通信|つうしん}{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい}のプラン。
{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい}だから{安心|あんしん}して{使|つか}える。
examples.english: It's unlimited, so I can use it without worry.

examples.japanese: このカフェはWi-Fi{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい}で{作業|さぎょう}しやすい。
examples.english: This cafe has unlimited Wi-Fi, which makes it easy to work.

notes:
{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい} follows the ～{放題|ほうだい} pattern meaning "as much as you want."

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-eat
- {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-drink
- {見|み}{放題|ほうだい}: unlimited viewing
- {聴|き}き{放題|ほうだい}: unlimited listening

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい} (unlimited data)
- Wi-Fi{使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい} (unlimited Wi-Fi)

RELATED TERMS:
- {定額|ていがく}: flat rate
- {無制限|むせいげん}: unlimited
